title: The presheaf map from the etale sum presheaf to direct image is linear over the constant sheaf of rings
statement:
Let $\pi:U\to X$ be a finite etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, $\Lambda_X$ and $\Lambda_U$ the constant sheaves of rings with value $\Lambda$ on the small etale sites $X_{\Et}$ and $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $M$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_U$-modules on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an object $V$ of $X_{\Et}$ write $V_U=V\times_XU$ with projections $p_V:V_U\to V$, $q_V:V_U\to U$; for an $X$-morphism $\varphi:V\to U$ write $(V,\varphi)$ for $V$ as an object of $U_{\Et}$ and $\Gamma_\varphi=(\mathrm{id}_V,\varphi):(V,\varphi)\to(V_U,q_V)$ for its graph, a morphism of $U_{\Et}$; let $e_\varphi:M(V,\varphi)\to M(V_U,q_V)$, the presheaf $P_M:V\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\operatorname{Hom}_X(V,U)}M(V,\varphi)$ on $X_{\Et}$ and the morphism of presheaves of $\Lambda$-modules $c^p_M:P_M\to\pi_*M$ be those of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-graph-section-extension-map] (with $P_M$ the presheaf of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] for $v=\pi$). Let $\gamma:\Lambda_X\to\pi_*\Lambda_U$ be the morphism of sheaves of rings of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact](1), induced through the universal property of sheafification by the constant sections, so that $\gamma_V:\Lambda_X(V)\to\Lambda_U(V_U,q_V)$, and give the direct image $\pi_*M$, $(\pi_*M)(V)=M(V_U,q_V)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], its structure of sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules through $\gamma$: $f\cdot t=\gamma_V(f)\,t$ for $f\in\Lambda_X(V)$, $t\in M(V_U,q_V)$ [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact](3). For an $X$-morphism $\varphi:V\to U$ let
$$\theta_{V,\varphi}=\Lambda_U(\Gamma_\varphi)\circ\gamma_V:\Lambda_X(V)\longrightarrow\Lambda_U(V,\varphi),$$
a ring homomorphism. Then:

1. For every morphism $a:V'\to V$ of $X_{\Et}$ and every $X$-morphism $\varphi:V\to U$, regarding $a$ as a morphism $(V',\varphi a)\to(V,\varphi)$ of $U_{\Et}$: $\theta_{V',\varphi a}(f|_{V'})=\Lambda_U(a)(\theta_{V,\varphi}(f))$ for all $f\in\Lambda_X(V)$.
2. Letting $f\in\Lambda_X(V)$ act on the summand $M(V,\varphi)$ of $P_M(V)$ by multiplication with $\theta_{V,\varphi}(f)$ makes $P_M$ a presheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] (the restriction maps of $P_M$ are semilinear); this is the $\mathcal O$-module structure of Stacks, Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DI, $\theta_{V,\varphi}$ playing the role of the identification $\mathcal O_U(V\xrightarrow{\varphi}U)=\mathcal O(V)$. For a morphism $\alpha:M\to M'$ of sheaves of $\Lambda_U$-modules, $P_\alpha=\bigoplus_\varphi\alpha_{(V,\varphi)}:P_M\to P_{M'}$ is a morphism of presheaves of $\Lambda_X$-modules.
3. For every $X$-morphism $\varphi:V\to U$, $f\in\Lambda_X(V)$ and $s\in M(V,\varphi)$: $e_\varphi(\theta_{V,\varphi}(f)\,s)=\gamma_V(f)\,e_\varphi(s)$. Consequently every $c^p_{M,V}:P_M(V)\to(\pi_*M)(V)$ is $\Lambda_X(V)$-linear for the structures of (2) and of $\pi_*M$ above, and $c^p_M:P_M\to\pi_*M$ is a morphism of presheaves of $\Lambda_X$-modules.

(Ingredients: $\gamma$ is a morphism of sheaves on $X_{\Et}$, so $\gamma_{V'}(f|_{V'})=\Lambda_U(a\times_X\mathrm{id}_U)(\gamma_V(f))$, and $(a\times_X\mathrm{id}_U)\circ\Gamma_{\varphi a}=\Gamma_\varphi\circ a$, which gives (1); (2) follows from (1) and the semilinearity of the restriction maps of $M$; for (3), $\gamma_V(f)e_\varphi(s)$ pulls back along $\Gamma_\varphi$ to $\theta_{V,\varphi}(f)s$ and restricts to $0$ off $\Gamma_\varphi(V)$, so equals $e_\varphi(\theta_{V,\varphi}(f)s)$ by the uniqueness in [lem-weil-pbc-etale-graph-section-extension-map](2).)

source.place: Lemma 03DI (lemma-extension-by-zero, line 2058) and its proof (the O-module structure f.s = fs on the presheaf V -> sum over phi of G(V -> U), with O_U(V/U)=O(V)); used in Etale Cohomology Lemma 0F4L (lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale, literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex line 11517), whose map is stated 'on abelian sheaves and sheaves of Lambda-modules' with the proof given only for abelian sheaves

mathlib_searches.query: presheaf of modules over the restriction of a sheaf of rings to a slice category, extension by zero along localization is O-linear
mathlib_searches.results: PresheafOfModules.mk, PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf), PresheafOfModules.freeObj (…Presheaf.Free), PresheafOfModules.restrictScalarsObj (…Presheaf.ChangeOfRings), ModuleCat.tildeInModuleCat: general constructors only; no module structure on the sum presheaf over Hom_X(V,U), no graph-section extension map

mathlib_searches.query: module structure on the direct sum over morphisms V -> U of sections of a sheaf of modules on the slice site, and linearity of the map into the pushforward
mathlib_searches.results: SheafOfModules.pushforwardSections, SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.PullbackFree), PresheafOfModules.pushforward and its simp lemmas (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.Pushforward): pushforward of modules along a continuous functor with a ring map phi : S -> F_*R (the analogue of the Lambda_X-structure of pi_*M through gamma), but nothing about P_M or e_phi

PresheafOfModules.sheafification (alpha : R0 -> R.obj, locally bijective), sheafificationAdjunction, sheafificationCompToSheaf (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.Sheafification): the universal property the definition node uses, not this linearity statement
only Sheaf/Quasicoherent.lean and Sheaf/PushforwardContinuous.lean mention Over (localization of modules, no sum over Hom(V,U)); no extension by zero of modules along a localization

PresheafOfModules.pushforward, pushforwardId, pushforwardComp, pushforward_map_app_apply (Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/Pushforward.lean); index unavailable, so not a proof of absence of anything else
